otura-examples.ifa

Otura: Networking

HTTP GET and POST requests for API communication (requires backend feature).

Use Case 1: Fetch Data from API

// fetch_data.ifa - HTTP GET request

ese get_users() {
    ayanmo response = Otura.gba("https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/users");
    Irosu.fo("Response received");
    pada response;
}

ese get_user(id) {
    ayanmo url = "https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/users/" + id;
    pada Otura.gba(url);
}

// Usage
ayanmo users = get_users();
Irosu.fo("Users data fetched");

ayanmo user = get_user(1);
Irosu.fo("User 1: " + user);

Use Case 2: Send Data to API

// post_data.ifa - HTTP POST request

ese create_user(name, email) {
    ayanmo payload = "{\"name\":\"" + name + "\",\"email\":\"" + email + "\"}";
    ayanmo response = Otura.ran("https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/users", payload);
    Irosu.fo("User created");
    pada response;
}

ese send_log(entry) {
    ayanmo response = Otura.ran("https://api.example.com/logs", entry);
    ti (response != ofifo) {
        Irosu.fo("Log sent");
    } bibẹkọ {
        Irosu.kigbe("Failed to send log");
    }
}

// Usage
ayanmo result = create_user("Alice", "alice@example.com");
Irosu.fo("Server response: " + result);

send_log("Server started at " + Iwori.akoko());
